title: Sañcetanāsuttaṃ
text: 194 . Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati…pe… ‘‘taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rāhula, rūpasañcetanā niccā vā aniccā vā’’ti? ‘‘Aniccā, bhante’’…pe… ‘‘saddasañcetanā…pe… gandhasañcetanā… rasasañcetanā … phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā… dhammasañcetanā niccā vā aniccā vā’’ti? ‘‘Aniccā, bhante’’…pe… ‘‘evaṃ passaṃ, rāhula, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasañcetanāyapi nibbindati…pe… saddasañcetanāyapi nibbindati… gandhasañcetanāyapi nibbindati… rasasañcetanāyapi nibbindati… phoṭṭhabbasañcetanāyapi nibbindati… dhammasañcetanāyapi nibbindati…pe… pajānātī’’ti. Sattamaṃ.
